title: I ported MapleStory v83 to PSP
author: Zontexo
selftext: PSP has 64mb of ram, managed to port the entire MapleStory v83 client, including mobs, quests, skills, jobs etc to PSP. Runs of 60FPS.

replies.author: Zontexo
replies.body: With Claude code and software engineering knowledge, ported to C and separated the large .wz files into single files that each file load a single map data into the ram not taking more than 20mb each time

comments.author: GayoMagno
comments.body: Hypothetical question, how hard do you think porting something like the Sims 4 or Crusader Kings 3 to Ipad OS using the mac versions would be? Both already run on Apple’s ARM silicon.

replies.author: Zontexo
replies.body: I think with today's AI all possible. It's just about consistency.

comments.body: This is exciting. I’d love to play this.

comments.body: What an exciting world we live in. I don’t know what will we get to see next. GTA 5 on a psp would be crazy

comments.body: This is sick I have a little modded vita would love to play maple on it

comments.author: G3nyah
comments.body: Wait did you port a single player variant onto the psp? That is awesome!

replies.author: Zontexo
replies.body: Yes, with all the Odinms files such as quests and all the skills and everything. Single player because PSP wifi is legacy but I was considering to try to add adhoc support so multiple PSP next to each other can play together

replies.author: Zontexo
replies.body: Oh btw. I port it also to web and Nintendo switch
